title: SensorFile
description: sens_###.json in a session directory (v0.2): ~5 s of wearable-node samples (Node B EMG envelope, Node A IMU), COLUMNAR like kin_###.json. t_ms arrays are session ms on the same clock as events.ndjson and kin chunks (the game maps device time to session time and records the mapping offset in session.json versions/device notes). Within each stream every array has the same length as its t_ms (not expressible in JSON Schema; validate.py --session checks it). At least one of emg_env / imu must be present.

t0_ms.description: session ms of the first sample of the chunk

source.description: udp = received from the nodes over Wi-Fi

emg_env.description: EMG envelope from Node B at 100 Hz, raw ADC units

motor_excl.description: optional per-sample flag: true when within a motor pulse + 50 ms (FR-AN-01 exclusion); same length as t_ms

imu.description: MPU6050 from Node A at 100 Hz: accel m/s2, gyro rad/s
